comment: HS mapping: declared 071220 (dried onions, whole/cut/sliced/powdered/broken) and 071290 (other dried vegetables; includes dried garlic 07129020 in Indian tariff) are CORRECT and cover the core range - dehydrated white onion, red onion, garlic, toasted onion, dehydrated vegetables in flakes/minced/granules/chopped/powder form. Status: partial, not exact, because two declared product lines on the site fall outside 0712: (1) FRIED ONION - fried/deep-fried onion is a prepared/preserved vegetable, not a dried vegetable; correct heading is 2005 (2005.20, onions prepared or preserved by vinegar/acetic acid or otherwise) - the declared codes do not cover it; (2) SPICES claimed in the site banner - would fall under 0904-0910, absent from the declaration, but no product page exists, so 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. No industry misclassification: 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is consistent with dehydrated vegetable processing. No trader signs found on the site (own facility, own procurement-to-finish chain claimed). Note: the site contains obvious template placeholders ('Lorem ipsum' blocks, 'Blog Title'), so the catalogue is thin and no downloadable product list or HS-tagged export catalogue was accessible; product sub-pages returned 404 during this pass. Per project rule 3, the HS gap is NOT a rejection ground - company is retained and the code set should be extended to include 2005.20 for fried onion (and 0904/0910 only if spices are confirmed). All product claims here are website-declared only; no customs line was checked in this role, so every line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at shipment level.
